text:
mira: Quick sync — want to lock final hero and subhead for Hosted / Dedicated / Private by EOD so the launch posts and webinar landing copy can ship. I made a tiny matrix in the doc: https://docs.google.com/hosted-dedicated-private-copy (please comment).

sam: On it. For Hosted I'm leaning into "fastest time-to-value" language, but we should call out predictable latency in the subhead.

olivia: +1. Hosted hero: 'Hosted API for instant LLM access'. Subhead idea: 'Fast results + predictable latency for production apps'. Short and web-friendly.

mira: Nice. Can we avoid 'instant' maybe, it's overused. How about 'Ready-to-use API for production-grade inference'?

olivia: Good. "Ready-to-use API" feels firmer.

noah: For Dedicated, customers care about throughput and isolation. Hero idea: 'Reserved GPU capacity for predictable performance'. Subhead: 'Guaranteed throughput, flexible autoscale and SLA-backed uptime'.

lia: For Private, we need compliance-first copy. Hero: 'Private deployment with customer-controlled networking'. Subhead: 'VPC, on-prem options, and enterprise key management'.

mira: Love those. Now a couple of asks: 1) launch post thread copy for social and blog (benchmark narrative + CTA to webinar signup). 2) webinar landing blurb + 1-2 key bullets. 3) inbound lead routing tags so SDRs know which motion (hosted/dedicated/private).

sam: Draft for social post (short): "New: Redwood Inference — consistent, production-grade LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Join our webinar to see benchmarks and migration patterns -> <signup link>".

olivia: For the blog/benchmark narrative let's make the headline data-first: 'How Redwood Delivers 2-3x Cost Savings on Multi-tenant Inference' then show perf vs naive batching and cache wins. Keep the lead paragraph simple: what problem, how we solve it, highlight smart routing & caching.

mira: Good framing. Add one callout about graceful degradation/fallbacks so customers see reliability story.

noah: Webinar landing first draft: 'Operational inference that scales: benchmarks, tradeoffs, and migration patterns.' Bullets: - Live demo of Hosted API latency profiles; - Deep dive on Dedicated autoscale & SLAs; - Private deployment checklist (networking, KMS). CTA: 'Reserve your seat — limited capacity'.

lia: Suggest we add a pre-webinar 15-min office hours for enterprise prospects — mark with tag `enterprise_interest`.

marketing-bot: Reminder: Upcoming events calendar shows webinar slot at 2026-04-07T16:00Z.

mira: Can the comms owner confirm time works? Also we need the signup form to attach an inbound routing rule: tag leads as `hosted`, `dedicated`, or `private` based on a radio button on the form. Then map to SFDC campaign + SDR queue.

sam: I'll update the Typeform with the radio and add hidden utm param `source=launch_webinar`. Routing spec: hosted -> growth SDRs, dedicated -> enterprise SDRs, private -> solutions engineering queue + AE notify.

olivia: For the landing CTA variants, quick copy options to A/B test: 1) 'See benchmarks' 2) 'Reserve my seat' 3) 'Get a migration playbook' — which do we prioritize?

mira: Prioritize 'See benchmarks' for acquisition channels, 'Reserve my seat' on the webinar page, 'Get a migration playbook' for sales-qualified flows. Document these in the launch checklist.

noah: Small nit on hero microcopy: avoid 'Guaranteed' in small print unless legal ok. Change to 'SLA-backed uptime available' for Dedicated.

lia: I'm drafting the short email follow-up for registrants: subject: 'Thanks for signing up — here's the benchmark preview' body: quick highlights + link to calendar invite + CTA to choose a time for 1:1. Will share a draft here later.

mira: Action items: @sam update form + inbound routing (due 3890012380). @olivia finalize three hero/subheads (due 3890012360). @noah draft webinar bullets + 1 pager (due 3890012388). @lia draft enterprise office hours blurb + email follow-up (due 3890012395). I'll compile the launch post and send final for review.

sam: Got it, will ping when done. :thumbsup:

olivia: I'll post the hero options in the doc in 30m.

noah: I'll put the webinar one-pager in the drive and tag you all.

marketing-bot: Note: Please use the 'launch-template-v2' in /marketing/templates for social copy to ensure legal approval flow.

mira: Thanks team — sync complete. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here and we'll escalate to PM.
